{{Quote|What do you want? I’ve done nothing. I’m all legit. Who are you, anyway? Mandalorians?|Leb Chura|<ref name="TC" />}}
'''Leb Chura''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was hired to pilot a shuttle that delivered six construction [[Droid/Legends|droids]], dry-lining materials and [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorumaa]]. During their hunt for Ko Sai, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Kal Skirata]], [[Walon Vau]], and [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] interrogated Chura on [[Mong'tar City]] about the job. After getting the information, Skirata rewarded Chura with a [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]].<ref name="TC" />

A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] later, he was again interrogated on [[Kerif City]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] who were also after Ko Sai. His memories of the job were then [[Memory rub/Legends|erased]] by Jusik to prevent anyone from getting the information again.<ref name="TC" />
